description: Ontario Wastewater Inventory (OWI) is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. Dataset containing information of industrial and communal facilities that discharge wastewater and have been inspected or are regulated under Environmental Compliance Approval's in Ontario. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. The portal shows 2025-06-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Not applicable. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
